title: Demonstrate 2jn's A1 and A5 live: ticfac init + ticfac run on claude in herdr, and one epic via run --cloud, on the merged binary
description:
2jn's A1 was traced by the review and tested with a stand-in child; no run in the epic started from 'ticfac init' then 'ticfac run <epic>' in herdr panes on claude (the run itself used GLM on local subprocesses), and A5's run --cloud is tested only against a fake factory. Run the next epic (t8u) that way and one small epic with --cloud, and record the evidence; this is the fourth epic that closed without the run its acceptance names.

ticfac run epic-2jn created this tick by absorbing the finding 08a0146a8e996e5bf729c700b88fdca00f17feb41ac84e913ab4517c73c9d049 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-rrl/attempt-54): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A1. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/08a0146a8e996e5bf729c700b88fdca00f17feb41ac84e913ab4517c73c9d049.json on the run branch.
